correctness.rationale: C7 independent columns have ≤3 vertices, and consecutive strong-product columns must form disjoint independent union, so each adjacent pair sums to ≤3. Summing across 2k labeled columns yields total ≤3k. Equality forces |S_i|+|S_{i+1}|=3 everywhere and |S_{i+2}|=|S_i|, hence precisely the (0,3) and (1,2) alternating types. C7 has seven independent triples; each (0,3) parity choice contributes 7^k. In (1,2) type direct enumeration of the 14 independent pairs shows M_{s,t}=3 for t=s, 1 for t=s±1, else 0, so weighted closed walks have trace(M^k), times two parity choices. Nonnegative symmetric M has eigenvalues ≤5 by row sum, proving fraction 1−O((5/7)^k). Fresh independent transfer over all 29 possible column states reproduced counts n=6,8,...,18 exactly 1316,7532,45836,291144,1905876,12741484,86430008. The stepwise cyclic equality proof gives the result for all k≥3, not finite extrapolation.
